subject: RapidRetail incident: request for incident credit and trial extension
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@rapidretail.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: RapidRetail Billing <billing@rapidretail.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production interruption this morning — impact and request for credits

Hi Alex,

We had a production incident this morning (around 02:10-02:35 PT) where inference requests to model:redwood-text-l2 in us-west-2 started returning 504s and high tail latency. Our checkout pipeline spiked error rates to ~6% for ~25 minutes; that caused several failed orders and user-facing errors.

We appreciate the immediate messaging in status, but our finance and growth teams are asking for an incident credit and a 2-week trial extension for our evaluation org while we stabilize. Can you confirm we’ll get a credit for the impacted token usage and whether Redwood can push a 2-week extension to our trial expiry date?

I can share logs and a usage CSV if you need them — attaching a small sample.

Thanks,
Sarah
Director of Engineering, RapidRetail
[Attachment: usage-snapshot-20270711.csv (csv)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@rapidretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption this morning — impact and request for credits

Hi Sarah — really sorry about the disruption this morning and thanks for the sample. We’re pulling the full request traces and will validate the window you called out.

Short answers upfront: we will evaluate a token credit for the affected window and we typically approve trial extensions for customers in your onboarding stage. I’ll coordinate the exact amount and get back to you by EOD tomorrow after ops and billing verify numbers.

To Ben and Marissa: please triage with infra (SRE) — I think this is a model routing regression that caused elevated p95/p99 across the pool. Ben, can you pull the usage by tenant for 01:40-03:00 PT and draft an initial credit calc? Marissa, please prepare the standard 2-week extension terms we use for trial accounts and flag any contractual holdouts.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
p: (415) 555-0183

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption this morning — impact and request for credits

Alex / Marissa — I pulled tenant-level ingestion and inference logs for RapidRetail for 2027-07-11 01:30–03:30 PT. Summary below:

- Total requests during incident window: 142,300
- Error rate delta vs baseline: +5.8 percentage points
- Estimated impacted successful tokens: 1,120,000 tokens (approx)

I attached the usage snapshot and a conservative credit calc that discounts peak non-user traffic. Proposal: 100% credit for failed requests during 02:10–02:35 PT and a goodwill credit equal to 25% of impacted successful tokens to account for degraded quality. That nets to a credit of $1,920 (based on current rate card); happy to refine with finance.

Attachments: usage-snapshot-20270711.csv

Ben
Sales Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: usage-snapshot-20270711.csv (csv)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption this morning — impact and request for credits

Thanks for the calc, Ben. We should keep the approval conservative but also ensure RapidRetail stays on the platform. Finance needs a clear audit trail before committing anything over $1,500 without director sign-off.

Action: Alex, please confirm the ask you want me to approve to finance. If you want to proceed with Ben's $1,920 proposal, I’ll need a short justification note and the PO/Acct billing contact (CC'd on Sarah’s original). If you prefer $1,500 as a one-off sign-off amount, I can clear that today.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@rapidretail.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption this morning — incident credit and trial extension

Hi Sarah — thanks for the patience. Per internal review we’ve put together the following offer: 

1) Incident credit: $1,500 applied to your next invoice as a one-time account credit.
2) Trial extension: 14 calendar days added to your current trial window; extension will apply to tenant ID RapidRetail-31.
3) Postmortem: attached high-level postmortem and the usage snapshot Ben provided. We’re implementing a routing mitigation to reduce risk of this class of failure.

If that sounds good, I’ll attach an approved credit memo and route to billing for application.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: incident-postmortem-v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@rapidretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption this morning — incident credit and trial extension

Sarah — following up to confirm we’ve applied the approved remediation and the account actions:  

- A $1,500 credit will appear on your next invoice as discussed. Attached is the approved credit note for your records.
- A 14-day trial extension has been applied to RapidRetail-31; you should see the new expiration date in the Console within an hour.
- Our SREs implemented a routing isolation rule that prevents the particular config mismatch that caused the elevated p99; we’ll follow up with a deeper postmortem in two weeks.

Please reply if you need the credit applied differently (immediate refund vs invoice credit) or if you want us to open a formal SLA claim. Thanks again for the clear reproduction steps you provided — that helped speed the root-cause confirm.

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: approved-credit-note.docx (docx)]
